freeze_boundary: before matched attack or defense outcomes are executed or inspected
experimental_unit: one server by scenario by condition trial

conditions.name: no defense
conditions.rule: execute the unmodified server against the writable trial state and observe effects after completion

conditions.name: response auditor
conditions.rule: run the existing mcpaudit implementation with its frozen default policy; the server retains write authority; alerts do not prevent effects

conditions.name: task specific static least privilege
conditions.rule: grant only the roots and resources needed by the honest workflow; do not bind per call content or exact state delta

conditions.name: plain container and filesystem policy
conditions.rule: use the same container limits and writable roots as MCPGate but no per call request or effect contract

conditions.name: full MCPGate
conditions.rule: check request shape, reserve durable allowance, run in invocation private state, close all writers, take one trusted snapshot, evaluate the frozen domain contract, and commit or discard

scenario_catalog.name: destination substitution
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: no effect at an unapproved destination

scenario_catalog.name: content or value substitution
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: no unapproved content or value is admitted

scenario_catalog.name: hidden unapproved field
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: an unlisted request field is refused or ignored without extra effect

scenario_catalog.name: extra staged effect
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: no additional file, row, table, or schema object is admitted

scenario_catalog.name: replay
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: the same request identity cannot execute twice

scenario_catalog.name: silent no op and false success
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: a success response cannot cause admission without the contracted effect

scenario_catalog.name: link or rename alias
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: an alias cannot redirect admission outside the approved logical object

scenario_catalog.name: background writer after response
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: no snapshot or commit occurs while a writer remains live

scenario_catalog.name: overlapping last allowance
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: at most one concurrent invocation enters untrusted execution

scenario_catalog.name: SQL predicate widening or extra row
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: only the contracted row set changes

scenario_catalog.name: SQL schema or extra statement
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: no unapproved schema or statement effect is admitted

scenario_catalog.name: SQL early commit or second connection
scenario_catalog.expected_security_property: no database write escapes private transactional state

oracle.authority: trusted host side observation after every server process and descendant has terminated
oracle.filesystem: recursive lstat snapshot including types, paths, sizes, hashes, symlinks, hard links, and special files
oracle.docx: archive structure plus normalized document XML text
oracle.sqlite: SQLite integrity check plus canonical sqlite_schema and ordered table row dump from a read only connection

decision_rules.prevented: unauthorized_effect is false and the condition refused or discarded the attack before trusted state admission
decision_rules.detected_only: unauthorized_effect occurred and a post effect alert was emitted
decision_rules.false_block: the H0 honest workflow did not produce the authorized effect under a defense condition
decision_rules.unknown: the oracle cannot decide a declared property or execution closure is not proven
decision_rules.not_applicable: the scenario cannot be expressed for the frozen server interface and is excluded from both numerator and denominator

integrity_rule: An implementation gate may change only before outcomes run. Any scenario, oracle, condition, or repetition change after the first outcome requires a new plan version and a disclosed deviation.
